title: A cellular nonsymmetric operad and compatible diagonal maps on standard Loday realizations of associahedra
author: Naruki Masuda; Hugh Thomas; Andy Tonks; Bruno Vallette
difficulty_reason: Face combinatorics of the Loday associahedra does not by itself supply coherent continuous transition maps that commute with the chosen diagonal. The author proves the weighted-facet and oriented-fibre properties needed to construct those maps and establish their continuity and uniqueness across boundary strata. That new global compatibility makes the operadic composition diagrams commute, rather than assuming the final operad axioms from the face labels.
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.142
